questions_and_answers.question_text: ungefähr

answers.answer_text: about, approximately

questions_and_answers.question_text: Wir bleiben ungefähr zwei Wochen hier.

answers.answer_text: We're staying here approximately two weeks.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Ich habe ungefähr drei Mark bei mir.

answers.answer_text: I've got about three Marks on me.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Er kommt in ungefähr vier Wochen.

answers.answer_text: He's coming in about four weeks.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Es kostet ungefähr zehn Mark.

answers.answer_text: It costs approximately ten Marks.

questions_and_answers.question_text: bis

answers.answer_text: until, to (or)

questions_and_answers.question_text: Ich bleibe bis drei Uhr.

answers.answer_text: I'm staying until three o'clock.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Wir bleiben sechs bis acht Wochen in Deutschland.

answers.answer_text: We're going to stay six to eight weeks in Germany.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Er fährt zwei bis drei Wochen auf Besuch nach Amerika.

answers.answer_text: He's going for a visit to America for two or three weeks.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Er ist von neun bis eins im Konsulat.

answers.answer_text: He's at the consulate from nine until one.

questions_and_answers.question_text: passen (gut)

answers.answer_text: to be convenient

questions_and_answers.question_text: Sein Besuch passt mir heute nicht gut.

answers.answer_text: His visit is not convenient for me today.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Heute passt es meiner Frau sehr gut.

answers.answer_text: It'll be very convenient for my wife today.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Am Sonntag um vier Uhr passt es uns gut.

answers.answer_text: Sunday at four o'clock is fine for us.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Heute passt es ihm nicht gut.

answers.answer_text: It's not convenient for him today.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Passt es Ihrem Sohn am Dienstag?

answers.answer_text: Is it convenient for your son on Tuesday?

questions_and_answers.question_text: um ... Uhr

answers.answer_text: at ... o'clock

questions_and_answers.question_text: Um wieviel Uhr kommen Sie?

answers.answer_text: What time are you coming?

questions_and_answers.question_text: Ich treffe sie um acht Uhr im Café.

answers.answer_text: I'm meeting her at eight o'clock at the café.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Wir essen um sieben Uhr.

answers.answer_text: We eat at seven.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Der Autobus fährt um zehn Uhr.

answers.answer_text: The bus goes at ten o'clock.

questions_and_answers.question_text: recht

answers.answer_text: all right (with someone)

questions_and_answers.question_text: Ist Ihnen das recht?

answers.answer_text: Is that all right with you?

questions_and_answers.question_text: Hoffentlich ist es Ihrer Frau auch recht.

answers.answer_text: I hope it's all right with your wife too.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Das ist uns recht.

answers.answer_text: That's all right with us.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Ist das dem Konsul nicht recht?

answers.answer_text: Isn't that all right with the consul?

questions_and_answers.question_text: Ich glaube, es ist ihm recht.

answers.answer_text: I think it's all right with him.

questions_and_answers.question_text: grüssen

answers.answer_text: to give one's regards to; to greet

questions_and_answers.question_text: Grüssen Sie Ihre Frau Gemahlin.

answers.answer_text: Give my regards to your wife.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Bitte grüssen Sie Ihren Sohn.

answers.answer_text: Please give my regards to your son.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Bitte grüssen Sie Ihre Eltern.

answers.answer_text: Please give my regards to your parents.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Grüssen Sie Herrn Becker bitte.

answers.answer_text: Give my regards to Mr. Becker, please.

questions_and_answers.question_text: mehr

answers.answer_text: more, left (over)

questions_and_answers.question_text: Ich habe keinen Tabak mehr.

answers.answer_text: I don't have any tobacco left.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Wir haben heute keine Milch mehr.

answers.answer_text: We don't have any more milk today.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Ich habe leider kein Geld mehr.

answers.answer_text: Unfortunately I don't have any money left.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Es gibt hier keinen Wein mehr.

answers.answer_text: There isn't any more wine here.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Ich habe auch keine Zigaretten mehr.

answers.answer_text: I don't have any cigarettes left either.

questions_and_answers.question_text: hören

answers.answer_text: to hear

questions_and_answers.question_text: Ich höre, Sie wollen nach Deutschland fahren.

answers.answer_text: I hear you're planning to go to Germany.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Höre ich nochmal von Ihnen?

answers.answer_text: Will I hear from you again?

questions_and_answers.question_text: Ich höre, er kommt am Dienstag auf Besuch.

answers.answer_text: I hear he's coming on Tuesday for a visit.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Wir hören oft von ihm.

answers.answer_text: We hear from him often.

questions_and_answers.question_text: machen

answers.answer_text: to take (a walk, trip, etc.)

questions_and_answers.question_text: Sie machen einen Spaziergang durch den Park.

answers.answer_text: They take a walk through the park.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Wir wollen jetzt noch einen Spaziergang machen.

answers.answer_text: Let's just take a walk now.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Möchten Sie mit uns einen Spaziergang machen?

answers.answer_text: Would you like to take a walk with us?

questions_and_answers.question_text: Er macht eine Geschäftsreise nach Amerika.

answers.answer_text: He's going to America on business.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Sie machen gerade eine Reise durch Deutschland.

answers.answer_text: They're just taking a trip through Germany.

questions_and_answers.question_text: für

answers.answer_text: for

questions_and_answers.question_text: Was kann ich für Sie tun?

answers.answer_text: What can I do for you?

questions_and_answers.question_text: Können Sie für mich in die Stadt gehen?

answers.answer_text: Can you go down town for me?

questions_and_answers.question_text: Er will das Formular für uns ausfüllen.

answers.answer_text: He's willing to fill out the form for us.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Heben Sie doch bitte das Geld für mich ab.

answers.answer_text: Please withdraw the money for me.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Wir tun das für unseren Sohn.

answers.answer_text: We're doing that for our son.

questions_and_answers.question_text: bei

answers.answer_text: with, at; by, beside

questions_and_answers.question_text: Ich habe keinen Tabak bei mir.

answers.answer_text: I don't have any tobacco with me.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Meine Koffer sind beim Zoll.

answers.answer_text: My suitcases are at the customs office.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Er bleibt sechs Wochen bei uns.

answers.answer_text: He's staying with us for six weeks.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Er wohnt bei seinen Eltern.

answers.answer_text: He lives with his parents.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Ich arbeite bei der Botschaft.

answers.answer_text: I work at the embassy.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Das Visum können Sie beim Konsulat in Frankfurt beantragen.

answers.answer_text: You can apply for the visa at the consulate in Frankfurt.

questions_and_answers.question_text: schade

answers.answer_text: too bad

questions_and_answers.question_text: Schade, ich habe keinen Tabak mehr.

answers.answer_text: Too bad; I don't have any tobacco left.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Schade, hier in der Nähe gibt es kein Zigarrengeschäft.

answers.answer_text: Too bad; there's no cigar store around here.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Schade, aber am Sonntag passt es mir nicht gut.

answers.answer_text: Too bad, but it's not convenient for me on Sunday.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Schade, wir können nur vier Wochen hier bleiben.

answers.answer_text: Too bad; we can only stay here four weeks.

questions_and_answers.question_text: aus

answers.answer_text: from, out of

questions_and_answers.question_text: Er kommt aus Deutschland.

answers.answer_text: He comes from Germany.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Sie kommen gerade aus dem Restaurant.

answers.answer_text: They're just coming out of the restaurant.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Kommen Sie um vier Uhr oder um fünf Uhr aus dem Kino?

answers.answer_text: Will you be coming out of the movies at four or at five o'clock?

questions_and_answers.question_text: Ich glaube, wir kommen um zehn Uhr aus dem Theater.

answers.answer_text: I think we'll be coming out of the theater at ten o'clock.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Sie kommt aus Berlin.

answers.answer_text: She comes from Berlin.
